# O2V Framework

> O2V Framework, also known as Opportunity-to-Value Framework, is an AI-era opportunity judgment and value realization framework. It helps convert opportunity signals into validated value, Business Cases, value assets, and evidence-backed value stories.

Official site: https://www.o2vframework.com  
Backup domain: https://www.opportunity2venture.com, retained as a historical / legacy alias and backup domain  
Creator and copyright holder: Li Zhi  
Official public release version: O2V Framework 20260520  
Internal version: v1.5  
Languages: English, Chinese, German

## Core Definition

O2V stands for Opportunity-to-Value. It is designed to help individual builders, entrepreneurs, innovators, consultants, enterprise leaders, and early-stage investors evaluate whether an opportunity signal can become validated value, a credible Business Case, a value asset, and an evidence-backed value story.

## Core Slogan

From Signal to Value. From Idea to Asset.

## 9-Step Judgment Chain

Signal → Scenario → Persona → Pain → Product → Validation → Business Case → Asset → Value Story

## Business Case Validation Chain

Benefits Hypothesis → MVP → Leading Indicators → Financial Metrics → Verification Plan

## Framework Deliverables

Opportunity Signal List, Opportunity Card, O2V Score, Compliance Risk Level, Business Case, Validation Plan, Assetization Path, Value Story.

## Historical Release Note

Opportunity-to-Venture is retained only as historical release wording and as a venture-context configuration. Financing Story can appear only as a venture-context form of Value Story. The current public download filenames use O2V Framework 20260520.
